name: Niao Zhi Mi
source:
A visual novel set in a world where humanity stands as the last remnant of life. Follow a factory worker's unexpected journey as he rescues a bird, sparking a quirky yet romantic adventure. The arrival of a mysterious girl unveils deeper secrets that will forever change his world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2784960/]Steam[/url]]
